title: add-policy-provenance-ledger-and-kms-tagged-audit-watermark
author: Maya Cohen
description: Summary: Introduces a policy provenance ledger and KMS-tagged audit watermarking to provide cryptographic proof of 'where' and 'when' RBAC decisions were applied. This PR implements an append-only provenance ledger, a KMS-backed watermark signer that attaches signed assertions to audit events, an operator-approval queue (RBAC v2 extension) that records consent flows, and a migration to backfill provenance markers on recent audit data. Motivation: Customers in regulated industries require provable chains-of-custody for authorization decisions and region residency at decision time. Existing audit logs are useful but lack an easy-to-verify cryptographic binding to KMS key material and policy versioning. This work closes that gap while preserving existing audit consumers.
commits: 3 commits: 1) feat(provenance): add ledger model and storage adapter; 2) feat(audit): implement watermark signer and attach to audit forwarder; 3) chore(docs+migrations): add migration script and provenance docs + tests
review_comments:
Priya: Can we avoid blocking the forwarder on KMS when KMS is transient? Please add fallback envelope behavior.
Author (Maya): Added async sign-and-attach with local cache plus envelope fallback; documented in comments and tests.
Diego: Migration may scan too much history — add batching and rate-limiting to migration job.
Author: Migration rewritten to use cursored batches, added throttling configurable via installer flags.
Lucas: Add Prometheus metrics for ledger write latency and watermark failure counts.
Author: Metrics added (provenance_write_latency_seconds, watermark_sign_errors_total). Tests: initial CI run had one flaky test (provenance_e2e_test) failing due to mocked KMS timeout; fixed by stabilizing test harness and adding retry. Final reviews: Priya and Diego approved, Lucas approved after small telemetry fix.
ci_checks: CI: build ✓, unit tests ✓, integration (provenance_e2e) flaky -> fixed ✓ after rerun, linters ✓, security-scan ✓ (no secrets found).
release_notes: Adds policy provenance ledger and KMS-signed audit watermarks. New operator-approval queue records consent flows for RBAC v2. Backfill migration included. Opt-in via installer flag --enable-provenance. No breaking API changes.
notes_on_deploy: Installer flag --enable-provenance defaults to false. When enabled, the migration job must be run (pkg/installer/migrations/202602_add_provenance_watermark.sql). KMS key ARN must be provided via PROVENANCE_KMS_KEY; if not present, system falls back to HMAC-mode with limited cross-region guarantees. Monitor provenance_write_latency_seconds and watermark_sign_errors_total after rollout.
security_considerations: Signed watermarks use customer or system KMS key; key usage permissions are documented. Migration touches recent audit rows only (configurable window) and writes provenance entries under a separate append-only table with strict RBAC. No plaintext key material is stored. Added unit tests for signature verification and negative tests for replay scenarios.
impact_summary: Operational: small additional latency on audit forward path (async sign, typical median +4ms) and additional storage for ledger entries. Compliance: provides cryptographic evidence for residency and policy version. Opt-in rollout minimizes blast radius.
qa_instructions: 1) Start local cluster with PROVENANCE_KMS_KEY pointing to test key; enable --enable-provenance. 2) Run migration job against staging DB with --migration-batch-size=1000. 3) Exercise operator-approval flow and confirm ledger row and signed watermark in audit forwarder payload. 4) Verify metrics and that fallback HMAC mode triggers when KMS simulated outage.
